name: Reliable LINE group onboarding confirmation
type: AM Platform / LINE onboarding / confirmation reliability
scope: Normalize common LINE quotation, invisible-character, spacing, and full-width command variants
Fall back to an idempotent group push when the reply token cannot deliver the result
Log both reply and push delivery failures instead of silently discarding them

dataIsolation.guard: The existing groupId and tenant-local Notion guards remain authoritative; the change only improves command recognition and response delivery.

definitionOfDone: The reported Engineering AM command and common LINE formatting variants are recognized
Every recognized onboarding command attempts a visible success or failure response
A failed reply-token delivery attempts one idempotent push to the same source group
Cross-tenant duplicate binding and tenant-local storage guards remain unchanged
